name: 500MHz-600MHz 100W GaN Circulator IIsolator UAV Jammer Module
description: The 500MHz–600MHz 60W GaN Jammer Module is designed specifically for disrupting FPV signals from drones like DJI and Autel. Whether used in portable counter-drone units or integrated into fixed installations, the ACASOM 500MHz–600MHz GaN Jammer Module delivers the precision, durability, and flexibility required to secure airspace against modern UAV threats. Reliable, efficient, and mission-ready—it's the ideal solution for advanced drone defense.
